nusmp.page.book_key.ultimate_key: Ultimate Key Magic: Gate of the Last Lock - A colossal gate swings shut over the field and every foe is locked where they stand (original). Hold the page to cast: a long wind-up (about 6.5 seconds) holds you in place; you must be at FULL mana to start and ALL of it is taken at the release; a 14-block area hits up to 24 foes in three pulses and pulls the foes inward and leaves them slowed, fatigued, weakened and cursed with bad luck.
